name: com.mediaway.unity
description: Unity-specific glue (Texture2D/AudioClip conversion) over the Mediaway.Device.Camera/Mediaway.Device.Audio/Mediaway.Pipeline netstandard2.0 C# bindings (adr/0004-domain-feature-split.md mirrored at the C# layer — Mediaway.Device.* is now a package family, not one package). Does not itself contain the Mediaway bindings — restore Mediaway.Common/Mediaway.Device/Mediaway.Device.Camera/Mediaway.Device.Audio/Mediaway.Pipeline into the project via NuGetForUnity first. See ../../../docs/adr/0018-csharp-netstandard20-unity.md.

samples.description: Opens the default camera and displays polled frames on a RawImage via MediawayTextureConverter.
